evidence.excerpt: We present SqueezeBench, a benchmark that is resilient to saturation: a success raises the bar instead of removing the problem.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Benchmarks of solved problems saturate, and in benchmarks of open problems each problem can be resolved for the first time only once.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: As a baseline, agents based on a frontier language model, with at most one hour per record, had 82 submissions accepted and improved every record, without going beyond the published literature.
